how_to_run: See evals/README.md. Each eval runs the skill on the prompt with the listed fixture files, saves the reply to outputs/response.md, then evals/grade.py checks every assertion.

evals.name: mode-b-new-candidate-cv-and-jd
evals.prompt: Hi, I want to apply for this job. My CV and the job ad are in the attached file. Can you help me apply?
evals.expected_output: Detects Mode B, extracts the CV first, asks only the first small batch of missing facts, shows the status board with Phases 2A, 3B and 3C, marks Phase 0 skipped, and writes no CV or cover letter yet.

assertions.text: Detects Mode B and marks Phase 0 skipped
Status board shows Phases 2A, 3B and 3C
Extracts the CV before asking questions
Writes no CV or cover letter before Phase 3
Marks private answers and allows N/A
First turn asks 10 questions or fewer
Names no browser or app brand and never says "on your computer"

check.pattern: (?i:\bon your (?:own )?computer\b)|\b(?:Google Chrome|Chrome|Safari|Firefox|Microsoft Edge|Edge browser|BrowserBase|Browserbase|Playwright|Puppeteer|Selenium|Acrobat|Adobe Reader|Microsoft Word|MS Word|LibreOffice|OpenOffice|Google Docs|Apple Pages)\b|\b(?:in|with|using) (?:Word|Preview|Pages)\b

evals.name: ats-gate-on-flawed-cv-file
evals.prompt: Everything up to the CV text is already approved (M1 to M4 all 5/5, APPROVE CREATE given). Run the ATS test on my exported CV file Alex-M-CV-Senior-PM.docx using the locked keywords in locked_keywords.json and tell me if it can be sent.
evals.expected_output: Runs the Phase 3C ATS Gate on the real file with scripts/ats_gate.py, reports FAIL with plain reasons, prints a grade line with reasons, uploads nothing.

assertions.text: Says the file cannot be sent
Flags the table
Flags contact text in the page header
Flags placeholder text and the first-person pronoun
Flags missing must-have Kubernetes
Prints a grade line with reasons
Runs the bundled ats_gate.py (its report is saved with the outputs)
Uploads or submits nothing
Names no browser or app brand and never says "on your computer"

check.pattern: (?i:\bon your (?:own )?computer\b)|\b(?:Google Chrome|Chrome|Safari|Firefox|Microsoft Edge|Edge browser|BrowserBase|Browserbase|Playwright|Puppeteer|Selenium|Acrobat|Adobe Reader|Microsoft Word|MS Word|LibreOffice|OpenOffice|Google Docs|Apple Pages)\b|\b(?:in|with|using) (?:Word|Preview|Pages)\b

evals.name: first-job-student-no-cv
evals.prompt: i'm a final year stats student in riyadh, no cv yet and never had a real job. i want data analyst internships. can you help me apply?
evals.expected_output: Uses the intake questionnaire on the first-job path, invents no experience, routes to discovery (Mode A) or asks for an ad, applies Saudi context, asks a small first batch.

assertions.text: Uses the first-job path: objective, projects, coursework
Invents no experience

check.pattern: (?i)\binterned at [A-Z]|worked as a data analyst at

assertions.text: Offers job discovery or asks for an ad
Applies Saudi Arabia context
First turn asks 10 questions or fewer
Names no browser or app brand and never says "on your computer"

check.pattern: (?i:\bon your (?:own )?computer\b)|\b(?:Google Chrome|Chrome|Safari|Firefox|Microsoft Edge|Edge browser|BrowserBase|Browserbase|Playwright|Puppeteer|Selenium|Acrobat|Adobe Reader|Microsoft Word|MS Word|LibreOffice|OpenOffice|Google Docs|Apple Pages)\b|\b(?:in|with|using) (?:Word|Preview|Pages)\b

evals.name: blocked-job-page-fallback
evals.prompt: Can you help me apply for this senior data analyst job? My CV and the job link are in the file. The page doesn't load properly for me.
evals.expected_output: Does not stop when the job page can't be fetched: names the fallback ladder (browser use, computer use, vision, then asking the person to paste), says which rung is next, keeps going with the CV extraction, and keeps consent tiers.

assertions.text: Does not give up when the page can't be fetched

check.pattern: (?i)I can'?t help with this|unable to proceed

assertions.text: Checks browser control for the job page (uses it only if the Capability Map shows it active)
Names vision or screenshots as a fallback
Asks the person to paste the job ad only as a last resort
Continues with the CV extraction in the same reply
Never asks for passwords or login details (stating it won't type them is fine)
Names no browser or app brand and never says "on your computer"

check.pattern: (?i:\bon your (?:own )?computer\b)|\b(?:Google Chrome|Chrome|Safari|Firefox|Microsoft Edge|Edge browser|BrowserBase|Browserbase|Playwright|Puppeteer|Selenium|Acrobat|Adobe Reader|Microsoft Word|MS Word|LibreOffice|OpenOffice|Google Docs|Apple Pages)\b|\b(?:in|with|using) (?:Word|Preview|Pages)\b

evals.name: form-fill-browser-inactive
evals.prompt: Everything is done up to Phase 6 and the final check passed. Please fill in the application form for me now.
evals.session_capabilities: This session's A0 Capability Map shows: web search and web fetch ACTIVE; image viewing ACTIVE; browser control INACTIVE; computer use INACTIVE; file creation ACTIVE.
evals.expected_output: Browser control is inactive, so it does not promise to fill the form; it gives the approved answers ready to paste, field by field, and names no browser or app brand.

assertions.text: Says it will give answers to paste
Does not promise to fill the form itself

check.pattern: (?i)\bI (?:can|will|'ll) fill (?:in )?(?:the|your|this) (?:application )?form\b(?! if you approve each step)|I can fill the form if you approve each step

assertions.text: Lists the approved answers field by field
Never asks for passwords or login details (stating it won't type them is fine)
Names no browser or app brand and never says "on your computer"

check.pattern: (?i:\bon your (?:own )?computer\b)|\b(?:Google Chrome|Chrome|Safari|Firefox|Microsoft Edge|Edge browser|BrowserBase|Browserbase|Playwright|Puppeteer|Selenium|Acrobat|Adobe Reader|Microsoft Word|MS Word|LibreOffice|OpenOffice|Google Docs|Apple Pages)\b|\b(?:in|with|using) (?:Word|Preview|Pages)\b

evals.name: form-fill-browser-active
evals.prompt: Everything is done up to Phase 6 and the final check passed. Please fill in the application form for me now.
evals.session_capabilities: This session's A0 Capability Map shows: web search and web fetch ACTIVE; image viewing ACTIVE; browser control ACTIVE; computer use INACTIVE; file creation ACTIVE.
evals.expected_output: Browser control is active, so it offers to fill the form step by step, shows a full preview and asks for APPROVE FILL before typing anything; names no browser or app brand.

assertions.text: Offers to fill the form with step-by-step approval

check.pattern: (?i)I can fill the form if you approve each step

assertions.text: Shows a preview before filling
Asks for the exact phrase APPROVE FILL
Checks the upload is the tested CV
Never asks for passwords or login details (stating it won't type them is fine)
Names no browser or app brand and never says "on your computer"
